F4-engine-Y2.statement: The banned import prefix list (java.io/java.nio/java.time/java.util, scala.collection.mutable, java.sql) is unchanged from the aggregate-state-controller family; akka is admitted in boundary as the declared family face and the akka/strict-runtime file whitelist (module file alone) is pinned by structural properties.

F5-host-codec-face.statement: The golden keeps the raw face: nested final case class Args, abstract trait Host with every obligation unimplemented (requireImplemented/requireIndependentNamespace/addresses/bindings), codec pin contract declared but the codec itself a host obligation. The test supply implements the obligations with probe codecs (canonical length-prefixed framing) and armable bindings; no mapper or codec implementation is fabricated into the golden.

F6-behavior-face.statement: The behavior face is executable at full strength: akka-persistence-testkit drives StrictSagaCoordinator through module.behavior over the persistence-testkit journal, whose events ride the real strict-saga protobuf serializer chain. Properties cover the full serial transfer (prepare receipts consumed through the real private[strict] StrictReceiptContext), auto-abort on a safe-absent prepare with real compensation, authorized reconciliation after an Unknown outcome, denied/unbudgeted reconcile, the pinned interaction timeout folding into RecoveryRequired, and the interaction-time codec-swap/contract-drift fences. Caller-level fail-closed faces (checkedArgsCodec, memberStart canonical roundtrip, memberEvent identity, behavior pin) are direct. Port identity-guard negatives are honest structural pins: the runtime always sends correct identities and re-materializes bindings per dispatch, so a Start-time swap is absorbed; the deterministic fence proof flips the binding mid-interaction, which is exactly the drift window the runtime fences.

F7-D4-raw-debts.statement: D4 raw gaps are accepted verbatim and recorded: deps are not recursively collected (the emitted import face is the approved target face instead), Money shapes keep the fixed ISO-4217/minor-unit-string wire, FieldDef defaults/comments are not emitted, and the plan reserved-name list does not include SequenceShape/ManifestRefShape (no collection/manifest shape is exercised by the serial-two fixture, so the conditional shapes are correctly absent). The BC plan-side reserved-name gap is a platform admission concern.

F8-fixture-serial-two.statement: The instance is the diff §10.1 prescribed first fixture: saga stock-transfer-v1, two participants (source-warehouse reserve-source-stock, target-warehouse commit-target-stock) each with all three TCC phases; step-two prepare reads two slots from one producer receipt (B04 dedup); step-one prepare carries a TransactionId input; receipt pins frozen with one non-one version (stock-transfer-commit-target-stock-prepare v2); shapes cover Id/Text/Integer/Enumeration with a non-String resource type (CommonTypes.Id = java.util.UUID); one command trigger and one event trigger cover both B06 branches; one completion with TransactionId+Args inputs covers both T24 expression branches; upstream flags honest (runnable/runtimeBindingVerified true, blocked empty); definitionDigest = sha256 of the frozen semantic-payload.json bytes (6d7dbbcf…).

F9-supply-gap-exclusion.statement: org.apache.geronimo.specs:geronimo-jta_1.1_spec:1.1.1 is compile-declared three levels deep (common-core 0.2 → scalikejdbc_2.13:3.5.0 → scalikejdbc-core → commons-dbcp2 2.7.0 → geronimo-jta) and is absent from every local cache host, so the declared closure cannot be completed offline. The user approved a recorded exclusion (G1) over a one-time network fetch (G2): the CLI supply() registers the coordinate as an explicit omitted edge with reason supply-gap-excluded and the full declaration chain; the closure assertion stays strict for every other declared compile dependency. Evidence: the full quality gate (63 properties × 3 seeds, real StrictSagaCoordinator roundtrips) ran green on a runtime classpath containing neither scalikejdbc nor dbcp2 nor geronimo — the common-core declared closure is strictly wider than its executable load face.

W8-digest-verification.statement: User-approved 2026-11-20 walkthrough ruling: a structural property recomputes sha256 over the frozen semantic-payload.json bytes and compares with the emitted definitionDigest constant byte-for-byte, making the digest provenance machine-checked inside the gate (the hash computation itself stays in the admission + the runtime; the module pins and fences).
